headline: MultiChoice Simplifies Nigeria DStv and GOtv Packages Starting at $4.42
summary: MultiChoice Nigeria simplified its DStv and GOtv broadcast offerings into four distinct tiers each, with basic DStv subscriptions priced at 6,000 naira ($4.42) monthly.
why: MultiChoice is Africa's largest pay-TV broadcast operator, serving millions of households across sub-Saharan countries.
